Name: NCA Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CSCC-1:2019)
Description: The Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CSCC-1:2019) framework issued by the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) of Saudi Arabia for Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Requirements.Name: CCG-1 Cloud Cybersecurity Governance
Requirements.Description: Cloud security policies and service account boundaries must be established.

Requirements.Name: CCD-1 Cloud Identity and Access Management
Requirements.Description: Enforce strict separation of duties, no user-managed service account keys, and least privilege.

Requirements.Name: CCD-2 Cloud Data & Storage Protection
Requirements.Description: Protect Cloud Storage and database instances with CMEK and public access prevention.

Requirements.Name: CCD-3 Cloud Network & Perimeter Defense
Requirements.Description: VPC firewall rules must restrict open inbound access from the public internet.

Requirements.Name: CCD-6 Cloud Logging, Auditing & SIEM Ingestion
Requirements.Description: Cloud audit log filters and metric alerts must be active for monitoring security events.
